data.content_ref: inline:SRC_005 depends on SRC_004 because the adversarial evaluation design prescribed by SRC_005 provides the experimental conditions necessary to observe the interaction term between checklist adherence and outcome on the expert's domain of strength specified by SRC_004. This dependence is REFUTED IF SRC_004's adherence-outcome dissociation can be reliably measured on a randomly sampled, non-adversarial evaluation set without any distribution shift.
